### 6. 🏃‍♀️ Run Club SF — Weekly Group Runs (Tue/Thu/Sat)
- **Venue:** Golden Gate Park (Tue), Kezar Stadium (Thu), Various (Sat)
- **Date/Time:** 
Tuesdays at 6:30 PM in Golden Gate Park, Thursdays at 6:30 PM at Kezar Stadium, and Saturdays at 9 AM at various locations

- **Price:** Free to join
- 
Run Club SF calls itself "a social club with a running problem," and the bar to join is friendly: if you can manage a couple of miles at a 12-minute pace, you're in.


---

### 7. 🤸 November Project SF — Free Weekly Workouts
- **Venue:** Rotating locations across SF (often at dawn)
- **Date/Time:** Multiple times per week; check november-project.com
- **Price:** Free — no sign-up required
- 
The SF chapter meets multiple times a week at rotating locations across the city, often at dawn. The culture is radically inclusive — no one cares about your pace, and the post-workout energy (group hugs, the loud enthusiasm, strangers-who-become-friends dynamic) is what draws people back.


---

### 8. 🐌 Slow Runners Club — Sunday Morning Run
- **Venue:** Panhandle (Baker & Oak), Golden Gate Park
- **Date/Time:** 
Sundays at 10 AM at the Panhandle (Baker & Oak) for runs through Golden Gate Park; each run starts with a warm-up and ends with optional coffee nearby.

- **Price:** Free (Meetup.com group)
- 
With 2,599 members and a 5.0 rating, Slow Runners Club welcomes all experience levels and all paces, though most members run between 10–15:00 min/mile.
